Anthropic.trains_by_default: No. Consumer chats are used for training only if you turn that on.
Anthropic.opt_out: Settings, then Privacy. Leave Help improve Claude off.

OpenAI.trains_by_default: Yes on personal Free, Plus, and Pro. Improve the model for everyone is on by default.
OpenAI.opt_out: Settings, Data controls, turn off Improve the model for everyone.

Google.trains_by_default: Yes for adults. Gemini Apps Activity is on by default, and those chats can be used to improve Google AI.
Google.opt_out: Gemini Apps Activity, turn off Keep Activity. Safety review can still apply.

Moonshot AI.trains_by_default: Yes. The Kimi consumer policy says prompts and files can be used to improve models.
Moonshot AI.opt_out: Ask Kimi support to stop training use if the app has no toggle.

Xiaomi.trains_by_default: No, if you download the weights and run them yourself. Hosted Xiaomi apps may differ.
Xiaomi.opt_out: Run the open weights on your own machine when chats must stay private.

DeepSeek.trains_by_default: Possibly. DeepSeek says some optimization data can come from user input, after de-identification.
DeepSeek.opt_out: Use the opt-out described in the DeepSeek privacy policy.
